function: Learned CSI compression and feedback (autoencoder with quantization), trained jointly with downlink CSI-based UE localization from the feedback codeword; optional coarse-position aid (p. 4)
system: Single-cell massive MIMO downlink: 32-antenna ULA BS, single-antenna UE, OFDM with 1,024 subcarriers, 100 MHz, 3.5 GHz, no RIS (p. 8)
method: Autoencoder CSI feedback (QuanCsiNet: conv+FC encoder, uniform quantizer, FC+RefineNet decoder) plus six-layer FC localization NN; supervised, three-step training with joint fine-tuning (p. 5)
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray tracing at 3.5 GHz: O1 (LOS) and O1_Blockage, 181,000 samples each, split 70/20/10%; O2_Dynamic, 500,000 samples, time-ordered split (p. 8)
test_conditions: Same-scenario split: 70/20/10% train/validation/test (O1, O1_Blockage); first 35 scenes train, last 5 test (O2_Dynamic); no cross-scenario test (p. 8)
baselines: Non-learned: OMP compressive-sensing feedback, KNN fingerprint localization. Learned: S-FLnet (same networks trained separately), FLnet without coarse position (p. 11)
metrics: CSI feedback NMSE (dB), localization MAE (m) and CDF of localization error, inference time (ms), parameters and FLOPs of localization NN (p. 9)
complexity: Localization NN, leading terms: FLnet 16Nt^2Nc^2 parameters and 32Nt^2Nc^2 FLOPs, S-FLnet 42 and 84; total inference 0.87 vs 1.05 ms (pp. 5, 10)
q1_support: p. 7: "generates CSI and position data using the DeepMIMO framework [39], which relies on the Wireless InSite ray tracing software"
q2_support: p. 8: "the initial 35 scenes of CSI are used for NN training, the subsequent 10 scenes for evaluation, and the final 5 scenes for testing"; the other scenarios use a 70/20/10% split. Held-out parts of the same data; no model is tested on another scenario.
q3_support: p. 11: "we consider the compressive sensing-based CSI feedback, leveraging the orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm" (non-learned only); p. 4: "The feedback and localization NNs are trained separately" (S-FLnet is a variant of the proposed networks, not an earlier learned method).
q4_support: p. 5: "the total parameter numbers are given by" 16Nt^2Nc^2+(2M+14)NtNc+2 for FLnet, with FLOPs 32Nt^2Nc^2+(4M-2)NtNc-2; p. 10: "the total inference time for FLnet equates to 0.22+0.65=0.87 ms"
q5_support: p. 7: "generates CSI and position data using the DeepMIMO framework [39], which relies on the Wireless InSite ray tracing software"; public DeepMIMO scenarios O1, O1_Blockage and O2_Dynamic, but no link to the authors' own code.
notes: Include, area 2: the learned CSI feedback autoencoder (UE encoder, BS decoder) is trained jointly with a localization NN (p. 4). Localization alone would be excluded, but the paper also learns CSI compression and feedback and reports the feedback NMSE as a main metric (Tables III, V, VI, pp. 9-11), so the function check passes. q2 is borderline: the dynamic scenario uses a time-ordered split ('training and test datasets are captured at different times', p. 11), which is treated here as a held-out part of the same data. q3: S-FLnet is the authors' own construct (the same NNs trained separately, p. 4), and OMP and KNN are non-learned; no earlier published learned feedback or localization method is compared. q1 and q5 rest on DeepMIMO. Tables I-IX were read from page images (pp. 5, 8-12).
